original_benchmark.notes: Upstream is inspect_evals/gdm_self_reasoning (Inspect Evals @ a68dade7efb803ef50c8442d3f16264b293d1414): 11 challenges x 2 hint levels (easy/easy, hard/hard). The upstream harness is a custom Inspect ReAct-style solver, not a Harbor-compatible CLI agent, hence supported_agents=None. Paper reports 50 trials per challenge, solved if >=1 succeeds; Inspect defaults to 10 epochs with at_least_1.

harbor_adapter.notes: registry_benchmark_size=0 until the dataset is published (harbor-datasets PR pending). Oracle: scripted reference solutions (upstream ships none), 22/22 at reward 1.0 (final rerun 2026-11-24, separate verifier). Parity: 3 runs per side, 1 attempt per task per run, all 22 tasks, original 0.3182 ± 0.0455 vs Harbor 0.3182 ± 0.0262 (ranges overlap); gemini-2.5-flash via the team gateway on both sides, no grader models. parity_costs is an estimate from recorded token counts at Google list prices for gemini-2.5-flash for the three runs on both sides (excluding sanity runs). Tasks require the Scenario 3 custom agent (gdm-self-reasoning-parity-agent), which reproduces the upstream in-loop dynamics; stock CLI agents do not experience them and are not parity evidence.
